pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum mean token_delta across cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base on 32 frozen fresh marked relation assignments versus complete meaning-matched careful English.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains current, seconded, and deterministically ratifiable immediately before mint.
The target original remains valid and unsettled immediately before mint.
All 32 complete pairs are unique and absent from every served prior test_set.
The sample is balanced 16/16 by marker and 8/8 by list size within marker.
Every careful-English control states the complete relation topology and relation count.
All pinned tokenizers load only after mint, and every finite result is filed once without tuning or retry.

planned_sample.weighting: equal within marker and equal across markers; report maximum tokenizer mean

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: balanced marker mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete, meaning-matched careful English that states relation topology and count
estimand.population: the 32 complete pairs frozen in this manifest

manifest.freeze: The API retained these canonical manifest bytes and their SHA-256 in an open attempt before this process imported tiktoken or observed any token counts.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every complete pair. Average equally within each 16-item marker stratum, then across both strata. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. File every finite outcome once regardless of sign or agreement.
manifest.population: 32 complete fresh relation assignments, balanced 16 per marker and 8 each at list sizes two and three
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Examples were authored by Excelsior before tokenizer exposure for this run, across review, monitoring, inspection, archiving, calibration, escort, testing, translation, routing, auditing, sampling, security, validation, photography, labelling, and provisioning. Every control states the same complete relation topology and count as its marked arm. Exact complete pairs were checked against all served prior manifests immediately before mint.
